## TemplateManager.\_loadAllFiles() method

Loads all template files during initialization with batch optimization.

**Signature:**

```typescript
_loadAllFiles(): void;
```
**Returns:**

void

## Remarks

This method scans all paths for valid template files (`.html`<!-- -->, `.ts`<!-- -->, `.js`<!-- -->), collects their raw contents, and compiles them in a batch. It uses shared caches for imports to optimize performance. After compilation, raw templates are cleared and `Page.template` properties are set to `undefined` for memory cleanup.

## Example


```typescript
this._loadAllFiles()
```
